segments.en: Learn system design by breaking a simulated concert ticket app and fixing it. Interactive pages covering 111 production engineering concepts.
segments.zh: 弄壞一個模擬的演唱會售票 App，再親手修好它，藉此學會系統設計。互動頁面涵蓋 111 個正式環境工程概念。
System Design Lab 系統設計實驗室

segments.en: Learn system design by breaking things on purpose.
segments.zh: 學系統設計，就從故意把東西弄壞開始。

segments.en: Every page is a small simulation of Encore, a fictional concert ticket app, as it grows from one server into a production system. You push traffic, cause the failure, apply the fix, and see why it works.
segments.zh: 每一頁都是 Encore 的小型模擬。Encore 是一個虛構的演唱會售票 App，會從一台伺服器一路成長為正式上線的系統。你負責灌流量、引發故障、套用解法，親眼看到它為什麼有效。

segments.en: Meet the teamAna builds the backend, Ben handles payments, Cai builds the frontend, and Dee keeps it all running. Each page drops them into a new problem.
segments.zh: 認識團隊Ana 負責後端，Ben 負責金流，Cai 負責前端，Dee 負責讓一切持續運作。每一頁都會把他們丟進一個新問題。

segments.en: A short situation from Encore's growth, in a sentence or two.
segments.zh: 一兩句話描述 Encore 成長途中遇到的狀況。

segments.en: A simulation with guided missions. Cause the failure, then apply the concept and compare.
segments.zh: 附帶引導任務的模擬。先引發故障，再套用概念並比較差異。

segments.en: The real config or code, mapped line by line. Then three scenario questions.
segments.zh: 真實的設定檔或程式碼，逐行對照。最後是三題情境題。

segments.en: All demos run in your browser. Numbers are simulated to show the shape of each problem, not to benchmark real systems.
segments.zh: 所有示範都在你的瀏覽器裡執行。數字是模擬的，用來呈現問題的樣貌，不是真實系統的效能基準。
